messages:
maya (marketing): Quick ask — we have the live demo + launch post next Wed. Need a short handoff/checklist from eng/runtime: reproducible bench CSVs, the exact command lines you ran, and a light rerun on quantized + fp16 variants for a 25k token sample. Can you help? :pray:

lucy (marketing-ops): Also: we need the artifact SHA + which model shard configs were used. Will use for the press kit and benchmark appendix. Ideally by EOD Tue.

aj (eng-runtime): We can do a light rerun. Two clarifying q's: 1) where should we upload the CSV + artifacts (s3 path)? 2) which quant configs exactly (int8, nf4, or specific config name)?

maya (marketing): s3://redwood-marketing/launch-2026/demo-bench is fine. For quant: please include the default int8-opt and fp16 baseline. If you have an nf4-like config, include that too and label it `nf4-like`.

sam (eng-runtime): Ack. We'll run three variants: `fp16`, `int8-opt`, `nf4-like`. Will attach provenance file with kernel versions and GPU types. Small note: warmup behavior affects cold-start claims — do you want cold-start numbers or steady-state?

nora (product): For the launch narrative, we need both: a cold-start sample (first 5 requests) and a steady-state run (10k requests). If that's expensive, prioritize cold-start + a 1k steady-state sweep.

aj (eng-runtime): OK prioritizing cold-start + 1k steady-state. Draft run commands below — please confirm payload path and sample selector.

aj (eng-runtime): ```bash
# example run (fp16)
python infra/bench/run.py \n  --model rwd-big-v1 \n  --quant fp16 \n  --payload s3://redwood-marketing/launch-2026/payloads/demo-25k.jsonl \n  --out s3://redwood-marketing/launch-2026/results/run-fp16.csv \n  --warmup 5 \n  --steady_requests 1000
```

lucy (marketing-ops): payload path correct. For the demo we only use the `demo-25k.jsonl` shard and a `cold-start` tag. Can you add a small README with which lines correspond to which prompt category?

sam (eng-runtime): Will add README and a provenance.json with fields: `commit`, `kernel`, `cuda`, `gpu_type`, `batch_size`, `sequence_len`, `quant_profile`. We'll also include the raw logs (trimmed) and a short markdown note about any non-deterministic ops.

aj (eng-runtime): Scheduling now. Estimated wall time for three variants: ~45m on current pool. If marketing needs verticals breakdown (chat vs. single-turn) say so now.

maya (marketing): Vertical split would be great but can be post-launch. For the one-pager, include mean latency, p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k-tokens (approx). Also flag any outliers.

deploy-bot: run queued -> id: run-2133337777-01, ETA: 50m, queue pos: 2 :rocket:

sam (eng-runtime): Logged run id. Will post final artifacts to s3 path and drop a short thread summary here when finished. If anything blocks, ping `@aj`.

maya (marketing): Amazing — thank you. If you can drop the CSV + README by Tue 18:00 PT that gives design time for the slide. :heart:

aj (eng-runtime): Understood — aiming for Tue 17:30 PT to give a buffer.

sam (eng-runtime): Quick note: we'll include a `bench_metadata.csv` with columns: `variant,commit,gpu,mean_p50_p95,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k_tokens,notes`.
